constants.name: K_DISPLACEMENT_BODY_MULT
constants.unit: multiple of the rolling average candle body
constants.rationale: Engine displacement test: body >= 1.5 x rolling average body (FVG C2 and CHoCH->MSS). Reused for every presenter 'displacement/expansion/strong move' proxy.

constants.name: K_DISPLACEMENT_LOOKBACK
constants.rationale: Window of the rolling average body. For the FVG displacement test the engine averages the 20 bodies before the judged candle, reproduced as avg(body[-1], 20); the CHoCH->MSS test lags one more candle.

constants.name: K_EQUAL_LEVEL_ATR
constants.unit: ATR(14) multiple of the evaluated timeframe
constants.rationale: Engine tolerance for 'the same price' (equal highs/lows). Reused for 'a level coincides with a PD array'.

constants.name: K_BPR_RECENCY_CANDLES
constants.rationale: Engine window for opposite FVGs forming a BPR.

constants.name: K_REJECTION_WICK_FRACTION
constants.rationale: Engine minimum wick share for a Rejection Block ('long wick').

constants.name: K_OB_LOOKBACK_CANDLES
constants.rationale: Engine lookback for an OB anchor / qualifying FVG and BOS.

constants.name: K_ST_MAX_CANDLES
constants.rationale: Presenters give no bound between the first and second FVG of the ST model ('displacement, retracement, displacement'); 20 candles keeps both FVGs inside one intraday leg on 1m-15m.

constants.name: K_TAP_LOOKBACK_CANDLES
constants.rationale: How long after an HTF array tap the 'first FVG away from the array' still counts; presenters say 'the very first FVG' without a time bound.

constants.name: K_CONSOLIDATION_CANDLES
constants.rationale: Window for the consolidation proxy (N-candle range <= K x ATR).

constants.name: K_CONSOLIDATION_RANGE_ATR
constants.rationale: Consolidation proxy: a 12-candle high-low range no larger than 2 ATR means no candle expanded the range materially.

constants.name: K_REACTION_WINDOW_CANDLES
constants.rationale: Proxy for 'immediately' after a sweep (reaction/rebalance must start within N candles).

constants.name: K_STOP_BUFFER_ATR
constants.unit: ATR(14) multiple of the entry timeframe
constants.rationale: Machine form of market-specific stop room the presenter gives in pips/points ('room to breathe'); default 1 ATR is a placeholder to be swept.

constants.name: K_OPEN_WINDOW_MINUTES
constants.rationale: Width of the window after the 08:30 / 09:30 NY equity-related opens in which a 'Judas' sweep is attributed to that open; the presenter names only the start times.
